percent.detail: 202 places remaining against the 300 budget cap. Internal cap is 350 for no-show headroom; fill rate is deliberately tracked against 300.

pace.detail: 98 at day 47 in 2027 against 73 at day 47 in 2026.

threshold.detail: 1.5x against 2026's 200 registrations, or 1.2x against its 250+ of known demand. The lower figure is fairer and still conservative — the waiting list was closed while filling.

projected_cap.detail: 2026's demand curve scaled by the current 1.34x, crossing 300 on day 134 of 239.

projected_race_day.detail: 2026's 250 scaled by the current 1.34x pace, capped at 300. Held flat past day 141 rather than extrapolated, so this is a floor.

prior_outcome.detail: Hit its 200 cap on day 127; 209 finally raced after a few were taken over cap. Waiting list reached 50 in 14 days, then closed — real demand was at least 250 and was never fully counted.
